d: Support the planning, coordination, execution, monitoring, and reporting of projects to ensure successful delivery within approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and governance requirements. The role assists project leadership in managing stakeholders, consultants, contractors, risks, and project controls while contributing to the achievement of project objectives and organizational priorities.
q: Support the development and maintenance of project execution plans, schedules, and milestones.
Coordinate project activities across internal departments, consultants, contractors, and external stakeholders.
Monitor project progress and track performance against scope, schedule, cost, and quality objectives.
Prepare project reports, dashboards, presentations, and management updates.
Maintain project documentation, records, risk registers, and issue logs.
Support stakeholder engagement activities and facilitate project meetings and workshops.
Assist in the review of consultant and contractor deliverables for compliance with project requirements.
Identify project risks and support mitigation and resolution actions.
Ensure adherence to project governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and reporting requirements.
Support procurement, contract administration, and project closeout activities as required.
Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Demonstrate accountability, professionalism, and collaboration in all project activities.
Continuously enhance project management knowledge, tools, and methodologies.
Support knowledge sharing and best-practice implementation across project teams.
Adhere to QIC values, policies, and compliance requirements.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Project Management, Business Administration, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required. Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is preferred.
PMP, PRINCE2, APM, or equivalent project management certification preferred.

Demonstrated proficiency in oral and written English and Arabic. Strong project planning, scheduling, stakeholder management, reporting, risk management, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and project management tools.
5–8 years of experience in project management, project coordination, development, construction, or a relevant industry, out of which 1–3 years in a supervisory or professional role

Prior experience in large-scale development, infrastructure, construction, real estate, entertainment, or giga-project environments is preferred. Proven experience of working with multiple stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and government entities.

d: Execute end-to-end operational purchasing for assigned routine, lower-complexity and time-sensitive requirements within the company. The Buyer coordinates quotations, purchase orders, suppliers and delivery follow-up to support media production, broadcasting, content, events and any corporate operations. Working alongside the Senior Procurement Specialist as a professional colleague, the Buyer may seek technical guidance when required but remains accountable for assigned purchasing activities.
Review assigned purchase requisitions for complete specifications, correct purchasing information and supporting documents; clarify requirements with end users.
Source suppliers, obtain quotations, issue routine RFQs, compare offers and negotiate standard prices, lead times and service terms within approved procedures.
Prepare and process purchase orders and related purchasing documents in Oracle Fusion, ensuring approvals are completed before any supplier commitment.
Track order acknowledgments, deliveries, service completion and outstanding items; coordinate receiving evidence and procurement close-out with relevant teams.
Serve as a day-to-day procurement contact for production, events, content, marketing and other business stakeholders on assigned operational purchases.
Coordinate routine requirements such as production consumables, equipment rentals, studio support, event logistics, creative services and other recurring needs.
Respond promptly to urgent or emergency buying needs; document requirements and escalate exceptions for approval in line with procurement policy.
Maintain purchasing trackers, provide status updates, follow up pending quotations and flag potential delays or supply issues early to the Procurement Team Leader.
Collaborate with the Senior Procurement Specialist on supplier follow-up, documentation and coordination where routine requirements connect with larger sourcing activities.
Seek practical guidance from the Senior Procurement Specialist on more technical supplier comparisons, sourcing approaches or complex procurement matters as needed.
Share supplier information, quotations, timelines and status updates to support coordinated delivery, while retaining direct responsibility for assigned Buyer transactions.
Escalate material commercial risks, non-compliance, unresolved disputes and matters requiring management decisions to the Procurement Team Leader.
Identify suitable suppliers for routine company needs and support supplier registration, onboarding, document collection and qualification checks.
Maintain responsive supplier relationships, follow up prices and quotations, monitor delivery and service quality and help resolve routine supply issues.
Coordinate purchasing documents, service deliverables and contract-related information with business teams, Finance and Legal when required.
Use approved suppliers, rate cards and framework or blanket agreements where applicable; highlight opportunities for better routine pricing and service.
Ensure every assigned transaction follows procurement policies, purchasing controls, delegated authorities and record-retention requirements.
Maintain accurate information and supporting records in Oracle Fusion Procurement, including sourcing activities, purchase orders and supplier-related workflows.
Prepare clear status summaries, quotation comparisons, purchasing trackers and basic spend or delivery reports for assigned requirements.
Support practical process improvements, accurate filing and continuous improvement of operational and urgent procurement workflows.

This is an individual-contributor role focused on routine and lower-complexity procurement within one company. The Buyer and Senior Procurement Specialist work collaboratively, with no supervisory or reporting relationship between them. The Senior Specialist handles larger-scale and more complex sourcing and may provide technical guidance; the Buyer owns assigned operational purchases and reports directly to the Group Procurement Team Leader. Neither position may make awards or commitments outside approved delegated authority.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.
Typically 3–5 years of procurement experience, including at least 2 years in operational or tactical purchasing.
Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Procurement (or an equivalent ERP), including purchasing, sourcing and supplier-related processes.
Experience in media production, events, broadcasting, entertainment or another fast-moving service environment is preferred.
Ability to manage routine RFQs, quotation comparisons, supplier coordination and urgent requests with accuracy and a strong service mindset.
Good proficiency in Microsoft Excel, purchasing trackers, reporting, supplier communication and procurement documentation.

Exposure to media-related procurement categories such as production equipment, creative services, venue rentals, event logistics and digital platforms; familiarity with rapid production and campaign timelines.
Competencies: organization, responsiveness, attention to detail, supplier communication, teamwork, integrity, time management and sound procurement judgment.
Performance measures: timely PO processing, quotation turnaround, complete documentation, supplier follow-up, on-time delivery and compliance for assigned purchases.

d: The Readymix Plant Labourer is responsible for carrying out manual labor activities associated with the production of ready-mix concrete, ensuring the cleanliness, safety, and efficient operation of the batching plant and surrounding yard areas. The role supports production operations by maintaining plant equipment, assisting operational staff, and ensuring housekeeping standards are consistently achieved.
q: Minimum 1 to 2 years of experience in construction, manufacturing, industrial plants, or ready-mix concrete operations preferred.
Ability to perform physically demanding manual labor activities.
Basic understanding of workplace safety practices.
Ability to follow instructions and work effectively within a team environment.
Willingness to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.
Good awareness of housekeeping and workplace cleanliness standards.
Knowledge of ready-mix concrete operations is an advantage.
r: li
Perform manual labor duties related to the production of ready-mix concrete.
li
Maintain excellent housekeeping standards throughout the batching plant, production areas, yard, and associated facilities.
li
Wash out and clean concrete batching plant mixers at the end of each production shift.
li
Ensure the concrete reclaimer area is kept clean and free from concrete buildup at all times.
li
Assist in cleaning, maintaining, and organizing plant equipment, tools, and operational areas.
li
Maintain all plant and equipment in a clean, safe, and serviceable condition.
li
Support plant operations by assisting Batchers, Shippers, Shovel Operators, and other operational personnel as required.
li
Follow instructions issued by supervisors and authorized personnel.
li
Assist with general yard activities, material handling, and plant maintenance tasks.
li
Report equipment defects, unsafe conditions, and operational issues to the Production Supervisor.

d: POSITION OBJECTIVE - The position holds responsibility to ensure inventory is maintained above set par levels at all times for the entire region i.e. U.A.E, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and Bahrain.
Oversee the flow of supply of goods both in bounds and out bounds, and efficient decision making to avoid stock out situations or expiries.
Achieving Departments objectives by ensuring there are no stock out situations at any given time across the regions and also find solutions to avoid expiries.
Represent the brand by maximizing and contributing to the supply of goods both in and out sales within the region through exceptional logistics and Supply Chain experience.

Achieve quantitative measures of performance in the following areas: Procurement of Goods with overseas suppliers, cost effective means of shipping both inbound and outbound, ensuring all movements are within the guide lines of the concerned government authorities rules and regulations, timely payment to the overseas supplier’s, Reconciliation basis value and stock quantities, monitoring stock status (available, held, m-inspect, expiry quantities). - Ensure supply of goods are made in the most cost effective move of transport and within the best transit time available. - Monitoring and ensuring that the right temperature is maintained at all times during the transportation of goods to ensure highest quality standards are maintained at all given times. - Adhere and enforce Company SOP, Policies and procedures; loss prevention audit guidelines at all times. Also create measures to ensure compliance by our service providers. - Oversea and support all regions to meet the guidelines set by the respective concerned govt. authorities.
Monitor the supply movement across the regions.
Share valuable information, knowledge with your subordinates, train on logistic perspective, govt. guidelines, teamwork, and other etiquettes as per the company and brand requirements.
